instrument: BINANCE_SPOT daily UTC; long/cash, no short/funding/leverage
disclosure: Previously observed calendar prices in different hypotheses; no global untouched-data claim. All three fixed hypotheses retained. No post-result parameter sweeps. Old failed futures and positive slow-spot studies preserved. Later data is reserved until this study passes its gates.

BULL_DIP.entry: close>EMA200 and RSI2<10 and close<previous close

REJECTED_SELLOFF.entry: close>EMA200 and previous close below previous lower Bollinger20/2sigma and current close back above current lower band and current close>open

SLOW_BREAKOUT.entry: close>EMA200 and close above previous55 daily highs

indicators: recursive EMA, WilderATR14 and WilderRSI2, population standard deviation; first250 admitted bars warmup
management: next daily open; signed actual fill risk; gap beyond SL/TP excluded; STOP_FIRST; no BE/partial/trail; max bars virtual close; stage-end unresolved OPEN not forced profit; one active position per symbol per mode, no same-day reentry
baselines: buy-hold net return per same admitted stage; not tradePF and not risk matched
earlier fixed channel/EMA slow-spot studies retained, no cherry-picking merged samples
